name: signor

download_files.format: TSV (no header, 28 columns + trailing empty col = 29 fields per row)
download_files.notes: Returns all human (Homo sapiens, taxid 9606) interactions. No authentication required. Column names derived from official release file header (getLatestRelease.php). Adds SIGNOR_SCORE at position 27 (not in release file). Tab-separated, UTF-8.

download_files.format: TSV (with header row, 27 named columns, values quoted when containing spaces/commas)
download_files.notes: Official quarterly release file covering ALL organisms. Redirects to the latest release (currently /releases/Apr2026_release.txt). Has official column header row. Lacks SIGNOR_SCORE column. Use getData.php?organism=9606 for human-only with SIGNOR_SCORE.

PhosphoSIGNOR-only endpoint (phosphorylation and dephosphorylation interactions). Paired-row format: each interaction appears twice (enzyme→phosphosite + phosphosite→substrate). 26,830 rows / 2 = ~13,415 unique interaction pairs. Columns: entityA, entityA_name, mechanism, effect, entityB, entityB_name, pmid, signor_id, signor-score. Already covered by prior v1.1 plugin.

schema.source: getData.php?organism=9606 — column names from official Apr2026_release.txt header

fields.name: IDA
fields.notes: UniProt accession for proteins; CHEBI:* for small molecules/chemicals; SIGNOR-C* for complexes; SIGNOR-PF* for protein families; SIGNOR-ST* for stimuli; SIGNOR-PH* for phenotypes

fields.name: SEQUENCE
fields.notes: Flanking sequence context around modification site; lowercase letter = modified residue

fields.name: TAX_ID
fields.notes: NCBI taxonomy ID; -1 for in vitro/unknown

fields.name: CELL_DATA
fields.notes: BTO cell line ontology ID; semicolon-delimited for multiple

fields.name: MODULATOR_COMPLEX
fields.notes: SIGNOR complex ID if entityA is a complex component

fields.name: TARGET_COMPLEX
fields.notes: SIGNOR complex ID if entityB is a complex component

fields.name: MODIFICATIONA
fields.notes: Post-translational modification state of entityA; often empty

fields.name: MODIFICATIONB
fields.notes: Post-translational modification state of entityB; often empty

fields.name: DIRECT
fields.notes: Whether interaction is direct (t) or indirect (f)

fields.name: NOTES
fields.notes: Curator notes or dataset tag; often empty

fields.name: SIGNOR_ID
fields.notes: Unique SIGNOR interaction ID — used as _id

fields.name: SIGNOR_SCORE
fields.notes: Confidence/reliability score 0-1; higher = more supported. Only in getData.php, not in release .txt files.

primary_key.notes: Globally unique per interaction. Pattern: SIGNOR-{6-digit integer}

plugin_inputs.scope: Human (taxid 9606) causal interactions only — all mechanisms (phosphorylation, binding, chemical activation, ubiquitination, etc.)
plugin_inputs.notes: Supersedes prior v1.1 PhosphoSIGNOR plugin (which covered only phosphorylation-specific 9-column TSV). This plugin ingests the full human SIGNOR interactome with all causal interaction types.

paper_vs_reality.notes: Small discrepancy (~1,500 rows) likely due to in vitro interactions (TAX_ID=-1) counted in getData.php but excluded from paper count, or minor update since paper submission

paper_vs_reality.observed: CC BY 4.0 (confirmed via paper and site)
PhosphoSIGNOR endpoint confirmed active with 26,830 paired rows (~13,415 phospho interactions)
Two confirmed endpoints: getData.php?organism=9606 and PhosphoSIGNOR/apis/v1/

risks: getData.php has no column header row — parser must hardcode column positions (mapped from official release file)
TAX_ID column includes -1 (in vitro/unknown) entries — parser should pass these through or filter per user preference
getData.php URL has no versioning — will return latest snapshot at dump time; version.py must derive release date from Last-Modified header or getLatestRelease redirect URL
SIGNOR_ID is unique per interaction but not a standard external identifier — downstream linking requires SIGNOR_ID or UniProt IDs
SENTENCE field contains long rich text that may cause index overhead
getData.php may change column count in future SIGNOR releases — version.py should check column count as a sanity check
